scope: Isolated S1 crash error pages. The experimental patch now includes servo-net, so embedder request interception cannot replace a crash error page. Fixtures observe Servo's real error page and check reload from it. No product dependency or runtime configuration changes.
owner_decisions: Patch servo-net so request interception cannot replace a crash error page (2026-11-26).
An error page is recoverable by navigating back, reloading, or editing the target URL (2026-11-24).

baseline.head: 7bfebae
baseline.note: The recovery evidence records three passing runs in each mode at this checkpoint. origin/main remained at 46eaa88 when this work started.

configuration.crash_page_check: Each fetched crash document must contain the engine's failure reason. Servo's crash.html embeds that reason. The check only orders the fixture and grants no host authority.

changes.name: Request interception replaced crash error pages
changes.observed: Servo's main_fetch set the crash network error and then still asked the embedder to intercept the request. An intercepted response replaced the error. Every earlier fixture crash document was the failed view's previous URL served by the fixture.
changes.fix: servo-net skips embedder interception for requests that carry crash details.

changes.name: Reload from a crash page inherited its sandboxing
changes.observed: With the real error page visible, reload loaded the previous URL with an opaque origin and scripts disabled. The crash page carries every creation sandboxing flag. An embedder reload asked the crash page's script thread to navigate, and that navigation inherited the crash page's flags.
changes.fix: The panic handler records the failed document's original load data for each crash pipeline. Reload of a crash pipeline replaces it with that load through the constellation instead of its script thread. The record is removed when the pipeline exits.

findings: Fetched crash documents now show Servo's error page with the failure reason in both modes.
Reload from the error page restores the previous URL with its real origin and running scripts. Back, forward, and a new URL still recover.

A crash document for a view at about:blank is blank. Servo loads about:blank synchronously, so the crash fetch never runs. The fixture asserts this for the shared popup. The product's native error state must cover it.
For a failed pending navigation, reload restores the replaced source page, not the failed target. A new URL retries the target.

local_validation.patch_reproduction: The patch applies to the seven published packages with patch -F 0 and no offsets. A fresh preparation reproduces the development sources byte for byte.
local_validation.binary_isolation: Each run used a private copy of its binary. The final build was rebuilt after the negative controls and matches the SHA-256 of both passing final reports.
local_validation.product_changes: None. Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, product crates, and installed natives are unchanged.

limitations: Multiprocess evidence uses unsandboxed children on macOS arm64 with software rendering.
The crash reload replacement uses default target snapshot parameters. A view that started with sandboxing from its opener or a frame would lose those flags on reload. No fixture covers that case.
Crash pages for about:blank documents remain blank.
History recovery is checked for top-level entries after one failure path. Nested browsing-context history remains unchecked.
No new Linux, native-input, release-performance, or remote CI evidence is claimed.
